security_requirements: Support ESP32-S3 secure boot and signed firmware verification.
Support ESP32-S3 flash encryption for key-at-rest experiments.
Expose a documented debug-lock and recovery policy before production use.
Keep private-key provisioning separate from normal USB signing transport.
review_requirements: Provide a local display large enough to show event kind, content summary, tags, and risk warnings.
Provide physical approve and reject controls with distinct tactile actions.
Require explicit approval for each sign_event request.
Reject signing when the displayed request id does not match the pending request.
Reject signing when the displayed approval_digest does not match the pending request review.
notes: This is a requirements scaffold, not a routed PCB.
TROPIC01 is optional until direct Schnorr or secure-key-wrapper feasibility is proven.
Camera support is optional and belongs to QR signer variants.
